name: NVIDIA Nemotron 4 Nano preview specs surface in TensorRT-LLM and FlashInfer code
title: NVIDIA Nemotron 4 Nano preview specs surface in TensorRT-LLM and FlashInfer code
summary: Public repo activity points to an unreleased Nemotron 4 family: a Nano preview onboarded on GB300 in TensorRT-LLM with 44 layers (mostly Gated DeltaProduct linear attention), 512 experts with 10 active, 1M context, vision input and multi-token prediction. Nothing is released yet.
